name: squirrelscan
description: Website QA tool built for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor). 300+ rules across SEO, performance, security, accessibility & agent experience: audit from the CLI, fix findings in code, publish reports, and connect over MCP.

interface.longDescription: squirrelscan audits your website for SEO, performance, security, accessibility, content and agent experience issues (300+ rules), scores site health, and gives your coding agent exact fixes. Run audits with the squirrel CLI, publish and share reports, and connect over the hosted MCP server.
